caption: The AI Copilot setup chat asks onboarding questions and first offers to build the bot with your own AI tool (Claude Code, Codex) before building in Landbot; the account name is hidden.
Our test bot in the builder: one Buttons block with two paths (AIBM-001 Export, AIBM-002 Proef), each leading to its own message; the banner shows 14 days left in the trial.
Preview of the AIBM-001 path: the bot returned exactly the answer we had written, including the code AIBM-X1; the account name is hidden.
Analyze > Conversations' Data after the preview runs: 'No metrics to show for this time frame' and the Raw Data Export button greyed out.
Monthly plans: Starter €40 per month with 500 chats, 100 AI chats and 2 seats listed; Professional €100, Professional WA €200.
Monthly Starter checkout: €40 plus €8.40 tax, total €48.40, with 'Free seats (1 seats)'; 'purchasing on behalf of a company' is ticked and the VAT ID field is required.
Annual Starter checkout: €480 minus a €96 discount, plus €80.64 tax, total €464.64.
